onchain.title: On-chain wallet
onchain.feeUnknown: Not known (not every input belongs to this wallet)
onchain.label: Label
onchain.noTransactionsHelp: Transactions of the node's wallet appear here. Receive on-chain to fund the wallet.
onchain.partial: Showing the newest {count} transactions. The node has older ones.
onchain.bound: This screen shows at most the newest {count} transactions.
onchain.reservedHelp: Reserved by a spend that is being built or whose outcome is not known yet.
onchain.noUtxosHelp: The wallet's coins appear here once it receives funds.
onchain.txMissing: This node's wallet has no transaction with this id among its newest {count}.
onchain.txUtxos: Coins of this wallet created by this transaction
onchain.explorerPrivacy: The explorer's operator sees which transaction you look up.
onchain.addressHint: An address does not say which chain it is for. Send only to an address meant for {chain}.
onchain.addressRequired: Enter the address to send to.
onchain.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number of sats, more than zero.
onchain.invalidRate: Enter a fee rate in sat/vB, more than zero, with at most three decimals.
onchain.rateUnavailable: The node has no estimate for this choice. Choose another or enter a rate.
onchain.feeHelp: Rates are the node's own estimates. Normal uses the node's estimate at the time of the preview.
onchain.maxFeeHelp: The maximum fee is the fee rate times the largest size this transaction can have with the coins chosen for it. Nothing is sent if the node's fee is above it.
onchain.chainWarning: This sends {coin} on {chain}. Check that the address is meant for this chain.
onchain.feeOverride: The fee is above one of your fee limits (the rate, or the share of the amount). Your password is needed to send.
onchain.duplicateWarning: A send of the same amount to the same address was made recently. Check it before sending again.
onchain.acknowledge: I checked: this is not a duplicate
onchain.confirmText: This sends {amount} {coin} on {chain} to the address below. At most {total} sat leaves the wallet, fee included. An on-chain send cannot be undone.
onchain.noLimits: Spending limits must be configured first.
onchain.retrySame: The answer did not arrive. Sending again repeats the same request: it cannot send twice.
onchain.stepUpReason: This send needs your password because of the spending limits.
onchain.stepUpFee: This send needs your password because its fee is above one of your fee limits.
onchain.feeCapPreview: The fee is above your fee limits (the rate, or the share of the amount). Choose a lower fee rate or a larger amount.
onchain.stillRunning: This send is still being processed. Check again in a moment.
onchain.setup.spend_policy_missing: Set the spending limits for this node before sending.
onchain.setup.restore_reconciliation: Spending is paused after a restore until the node has been read again. Try again later.
onchain.reason.malformed: This is not a valid address. Copy it again.
onchain.reason.wrong_network: This address is for another network than this node's.
onchain.reason.unknown_prefix: This address has a prefix this node does not use.
onchain.reason.unsupported: This kind of address is not supported.
onchain.fromLink: Opened from a link: check the details.
onchain.failedHelp: Nothing left the wallet. You can preview again.
onchain.failedFeeCap: Nothing left the wallet: the node's fee for this transaction was above the confirmed maximum. Choose a lower fee rate or a larger amount.
onchain.unknownHelp: The node did not confirm whether the transaction was sent. Its coins stay reserved until Lightning Pilot settles the send with the node, or until you resolve it by hand in the settings. Check again before sending anything else.
onchain.reason.insufficient_funds: The wallet's confirmed coins do not cover the amount and the fee.
